paragraphs: R' Elazar ben Shemua, Peah, chapter 5, mishnah 2; Yehudah ben Shemua, Rosh Hashanah 19a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פי״א־י״ז means Nehemiah chapter 11 verse 17, not an 11–17 chapter range. Earlier פ״יאחוז is machine output, not another Hyman witness. No named edition is independently checked.

פ״ה מ״ב explicitly gives Peah chapter 5 mishnah 2; יט. gives Rosh Hashanah 19a by the period convention, against earlier machine ים. The attestations remain separate; Yehudah has no title and Elazar remains R'.
